correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the tagged-coincidence Bernoulli argument p=(1−α)/(θ+1), K2=2−H and affine conditional K recursion: Cov(K_n,H)=−p(1−p)∏_{j=2}^{n−1}(θ+j+α)/(θ+j). Exchangeability proves all m≤n. For m>n, old–future and future–future coincidence probabilities cancel K_n and give E(Q_m−p|Π_n)=n(n−1)(θ+m)(θ+m+1)/[m(m−1)(θ+n)(θ+n+1)](Q_n−p). Signs follow θ+α>0, n=2/m=2 and α=0 boundaries checked. Independent exact rational CRP joint enumeration (α=2/3,θ=−1/3, n=2,3,4 and m=2,3,5,7, 12 tests) agreed and each state mass totaled one; finite tests do not prove the infinite claim. Gamma asymptotic is standard and the product matches its Γ expression.
